questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All javascript are binary.

All binary are minecraft.

All roblox are minecraft.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some javascript are roblox.

II. Some javascript are minecraft.

III. All javascript are minecraft.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97b377bc26b60545bee16b33211d40417c40da85509c97dcc15d106da0a8e3c7.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some javascript are roblox → Does not follow (As all javascript are binary, all binary are minecraft and all roblox are minecraft. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. Some javascript are minecraft → Follow (As all javascript are binary and all binary are minecraft. So, as whole javascript comes in binary which whole comes in minecraft therefore it is definitely true)

III. All javascript are minecraft → Follow (As all javascript are binary and all binary are minecraft. So, as whole javascript comes in binary which whole comes in minecraft therefore it is definitely true)

∴ Here, Only conclusions II and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusions II and III follow".

questions.question: Battle of Plassey was fought between English company and Nawab of Bengal in which year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1757.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The East India Company forces led by Robert Clive engaged Siraj-Ud-Daulah in the Battle of Plassey.
 
• Siraj-Ud-Daulah was the Nawab of Bengal.
 
• Siraj was enraged by the widespread abuse of trade privileges by EIC authorities.
 
• The battle of Plassey in 1757 was brought on by EIC's continued wrongdoing against Siraj-Ud-Daulah.
 
• About 160 kilometers north of Calcutta, close to the little settlement of Plassey (Palashi), the forces came together on the banks of the Bhagirathi-Hooghly River.
 
• On June 23, 1757, the Battle of Plassey was fought.
 
• Robert Clive's army of 3,000 troops destroyed Siraj-Ud-army Daulah's of 50,000 warriors, 40 cannons, and 10 war elephants.
 
• In 11 hours, the battle was over, and Siraj-Ud-Daulah fled after losing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Battle of Plassey was fought in north-eastern India on 23 June 1757.

questions.question: How many anions surround a sodium ion in a crystal lattice of sodium chloride?

• The** anion (Cl-) and the cation (Na+)** in the **crystal structure** alternate back and forth in a **predictable pattern.**
 
• The** cubic lattice of sodium ions** and a related** cubic lattice of chlorine ions** are entangled in the **crystal structure of sodium chloride.**
 
• **Thirteen sodium ions** and **fourteen chloride ions** make up each unit cell of sodium chloride.
 
• **Eight unit cells **share an ion at a corner, **two unit cells **share one at the **face's center, and four unit cells **share one at the edge.
 
• **Each sodium ion **is surrounded by **six chloride ions**, and **each chloride ion** is surrounded by **six sodium ions.**

• So we need to use the past form of the verb **'took.'**
